class.name: Box3DDirectSpaceState3D
class.description: [Box3DDirectSpaceState3D] is returned by [World3D.direct_space_state] when the Box3D physics server is active. It supports the stock [PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D] query API plus Box3D-specific material query helpers. For mesh hits, [code]face_index[/code] is Box3D's built mesh triangle index after BVH sorting. It is valid for [method Box3DPhysics.get_face_material], but must not be used to index authored triangle arrays directly.

method.name: intersect_ray_ex
method.description: Runs the same ray query as [method PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D.intersect_ray], and returns the stock hit keys plus [code]material_id[/code] and [code]material[/code]. Returns an empty dictionary on a miss. [code]material_id[/code] is the durable handle: store that, not the name, and resolve it with [method Box3DPhysics.surface]. [code]material[/code] is the same resource already resolved, so [code]material.material_name[/code] reads the name without a second lookup.
